REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, has_door_key & !door_open) -> u1
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, door_open) -> u2
(u1, key_lost) -> u1
(u1, else) -> u1
(u2, target_picked_up) -> u3
(u2, else) -> u2
(u3, else) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, has_door_key & !door_open, u1) -> 0.1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 0.3
(u1, key_lost, u1) -> -0.1
(u2, target_picked_up, u3) -> 1.0
feedback: Accepted. The RM is a faithful, minimal 4-state chain (no key -> key in hand -> door open -> box picked up) matching the task's ordered subgoals and the environment's constraint table. Labels are predicate-only and consistent with the valuation constraints: in u0 door_open is necessarily false (door_open cannot precede has_door_key, and first key acquisition moves the machine out of u0), so (has_door_key & !door_open) fires exactly at first key pickup; in u1, door_open and key_lost are mutually exclusive per the constraints, and re-acquiring the key after a drop is correctly absorbed by the u1 else-loop with no duplicate milestone reward (reward farming impossible). u2 correctly preserves the door milestone across door re-shut toggles and key re-pickup: the door is never relocked, so the box stays reachable and no regression transition is required there. key_lost is used as the one-step event that environment.md specifies: the explicit (u1, key_lost) self-loop with -0.1 is exactly the regression handling the task requires (dropping the key before the door opens), while the mandatory post-open drop in u2 fires no key_lost (door_open true) and carries no penalty, matching the environment note. Every state has a per-state else self-loop, so all irrelevant events (movement, turns, done, toggling a locked door, key_lost in u0/u2/u3, target_picked_up in u0/u1 which is impossible per constraints) are covered with zero reward. FINAL_STATES: u3 is present, declared in STATES, and accepting (target_picked_up is the episode-terminating step). Rewards are dense across the three milestones (0.1/0.3/1.0), each firing at most once, giving a bounded total of at most 1.4 minus penalties; the repeatable -0.1 key_lost penalty is a disincentive rather than an exploitable reward source, and the u0->u1 plus immediate key_lost pair nets zero, so no positive reward is obtainable without genuine progress. Format matches the paper artifact (STATES/INITIAL_STATE/INITIAL state/FINAL_STATES headers, (state,label)->state transitions, (state,label,state)->reward entries, else catch-alls). Verifying against the example trace: step 2 pickup -> u1 (+0.1), step 7 toggle -> u2 (+0.3), step 9 drop -> u2 else (0, correctly unpenalized since the door is open), step 18 pickup -> u3 (+1.0). Minor non-blocking notes: the !door_open conjunct in the u0 label is redundant given the constraints (harmless and explicit), and unlisted transitions implicitly carry 0 reward. No changes required.

All four environment-declared propositions are implemented, and no extra functions are present. 'has_door_key', 'door_open', and 'target_picked_up' exactly reproduce the documented truth conditions: carrying-state checks via env.carrying, a guarded grid scan for a door of matching color / is_open state, and mission-string matching via env.mission against f"pick up the {color} box" — no fixed color assumptions. Empty cells are guarded with 'c is not None' before attribute access, and only documented API members are used (env.carrying, env.mission, env.grid.get, env.width, env.height, object type/color/is_open). The persistent propositions read only current state; 'key_lost' is correctly implemented as an event, comparing env.episode_memory['previous_valuation']['has_door_key'] against the current inlined K and D expressions, matching the documented form prev['has_door_key'] and not K and not D. The leading bool(...) guard is a defensive read of the complete previous valuation and does not alter truth values, since the first-step valuation already makes has_door_key false and thus key_lost false on the opening step. The code is read-only: no imports, no action calls, no mutation of env or episode_memory, and syntax is valid Python. It aligns with the RM's proposition set and the environment's constraints (key_lost excludes door_open and carrying the key).
